package.name: xarm1s_grasp_plugin
package.description: Gazebo Classic 11 world plugin for the thesis sim: a CONTACT-TRIGGERED fixed-joint grasp. On /grasp/attach it arms an object, then welds it to the gripper only once both fingers are detected in sustained contact with it (so the gripper must genuinely close on the object first -- no grip-on-air, no teleport-attach); the object is then carried RIGIDLY (no /set_entity_state jitter). Released on /grasp/detach. This follows the GazeboGraspFix design (Buehler) and Gazebo's own physics::Gripper, which use the same zero-range-joint weld as a kinematic grasp constraint standing in for Gazebo's unreliable parallel-jaw friction on small/round objects.
